quarterly_data.quarter: Magnachip Semiconductor press release: Magnachip Launches 8th-Generation 40V and 60V MV MOSFETs (03-31-2026)
quarterly_data.signal: Launched 8th-generation 40V and 60V Medium-Voltage (MV) MOSFETs designed for the synchronous rectification stage of server and high-performance PC power supply units, using Advanced Shielded-Gate Trench (SGT) technology: the 40V products deliver up to 40% higher current density and approximately 25% faster switching than the previous generation, the 60V products up to 50% higher current density and 60% faster switching; operating temperature up to 175 C, PDFN56 package, JEDEC standards. Following the 0.7mOhm 40V product of May 2025, it adds 0.8mOhm 40V, 1.0mOhm 40V and 1.05mOhm 60V devices.
quarterly_data.figure: 40V: up to 40% current density, ~25% faster switching; 60V: up to 50% and 60% faster
